scope: Complete syntactic read of the named owner documents and all phase deltas; registered rule references only
semantic_limit: Reference occurrence classification is not proof of equivalence of all independent unnumbered prose. Selected changed obligations are manually mapped in W4-OWNERSHIP.md.

VERIFY-ORACLE-01.subject: regression evidence binds to the verifier that produced it

STATE-SHAPE-01.subject: STATE fields, enums and conditional shape

STATE-DFA-01.subject: phase enum, transition graph and ticket-bearing phases

CHECKPOINT-01.subject: LOG then BOARD then STATE checkpoint order

CMD-ROUTING-01.subject: canonical commands, shortcuts and Unicode normalization

INGRESS-AUTHORITY-01.subject: a refused ingress owes its bytes

OPERATOR-QUESTION-01.subject: native questions require canonical operator authority

EXEC-HUSH-01.subject: HUSH precedence, silence and mandatory output

EXEC-RESPONSE-01.subject: default response surface: control block first, DETAILS last

PHASE-DELTA-01.subject: 16 lazy phase documents and delta-only phase contracts

CONFORMANCE-CORPUS-01.subject: machine corpus completeness and generated human view

SOURCE-AUDIT-INBOX-01.subject: audit inbox transport identity, routing position and delete gate

SOURCE-AUDIT-ENQUEUE-01.subject: shared producer enqueue: monotonic never-reused ids, atomic placement, idempotent retry, optional untrusted envelope

EVIDENCE-RETENTION-01.subject: bounded durable proof, run-owned ephemeral cleanup, conservative historical classification and retention manifests

QUALITY-TIME-01.subject: model-independent acceptance; durable progress, not elapsed time, decides liveness

SOURCE-APPEND-01.subject: operational handoff appends are durable mission state: verbatim amending receipt, ordered ledger, deterministic clause derivation, supersession without deletion, minimum truthful rewind, unprojected append routed before continuation

SOURCE-DISTRIBUTION-01.subject: local authority and publication permission are separate states: DISTRIBUTABLE default, monotonic QUARANTINED, protected body never exported

STORE-SAFETY-01.subject: explicit durable trust, disposable scratch, verified atomic artifact promotion and honest state-loss recovery

FUTURE-GATE-01.subject: deferred authority is a lifecycle, not a document pile: a freshness witness over the corpus, an ambiguous document is never executable by guess, and routing refreshes and refines it itself so no dropped file waits on a manual command
